slice: Pair separately compiled variants using shared seeds captured from native initialization

decision.finding: Native-seed self-controls did not pass the predetermined precision gate, so no candidate comparison was run.
decision.scope: This diagnostic does not replace the original release measurements or establish universal zero execution cost.

method.gates: Launch and prepare each of four independent processes sequentially. Hold their existing enable acknowledgments until all are ready. Execute complete phases in ABBA/BAAB order, holding each disable acknowledgment until every process finishes. Only then permit output serialization, validation and exit.
method.statistics: Each group has two independent processes per label. Primary: ratio of the average process medians. Secondary: ratio of full-label means. Bootstrap whole four-process groups within four predetermined blocks, 10000 resamples, seed 88. Also report instruction changes. Do not treat within-process executions as independent process samples.
method.question: Does the five-line type shortcut affect execution when both separately compiled variants receive the same natively generated shared seed, retaining per-table randomness?
method.seed_capture_rule: Run exactly 16 fresh baseline benchmark processes in check-only mode with natural initialization. Record the initializer input before hashing. Use every captured input in capture order, including repeats or zero if they occur. No performance-based seed selection.
method.seed_assignment: Four captured seeds per block. Comparisons use all four; self-controls use the first and third. Baseline and candidate self-controls use the same selected inputs. Do not pool phases.
method.source: Both variants have the identical shared-seed replay/trace initializer and original native RandomState/IN lookup source. They differ only in the existing float type-inference patch. Per-table seed generation and ASLR remain natural.
method.calibration_criteria: A fixed 16-group, 64-process phase. Both variants must have median-based and mean-based 95% self-comparison intervals entirely within +/-1% and including zero.
method.comparison_criteria: Only after calibration passes, run the fixed 32-group, 128-process phase. Its contemporaneous self-controls must pass the same criteria. Candidate median-based and mean-based upper interval bounds must be below +0.5%, without a resolved positive effect.
method.stopping_rule: No discarded groups, seed replacements, added runs or changed thresholds. Failure in calibration blocks comparison. Capture inputs and finish all validation before a 30-second cooldown; do not overlap builds, tests or source inspection with timing.
limits: The initializer is diagnostic and the executables are rebuilt; this is not a rerun of the byte-identical original release binaries.
The replay controls the shared seed for foldhash 0.2.0 users of global_random, including planning maps; FixedState and per-table seed generation are unchanged.
Sixteen native generator outputs are a finite sample, not a guarantee over all seeds, SQL workloads or hosts.
Four processes remain resident and complete phases are scheduled sequentially; this retains the earlier allocation-lifetime and hardware-history limitations.

reproduction.setup: Use the frozen source inputs, recorded patches, override and paths in a fresh sibling cache directory. The protocol precedes seed capture. Keep all 16 native inputs and the predetermined assignment. Restore shared files in finally. Complete validation before timing, and retain failed controls.
